title: Particles 5: emphatic -то (Topic and Concession)
description: The emphatic particle -то (written with a hyphen) attaches to a content word to spotlight it as the topic (Погода-то хорошая!), to concede a point before a 'but' (Сделать-то я сделал, но...), or to soften a statement. This is the emphatic -то, not the indefinite -то of кто-то / где-то.
descriptionRussian: Выделительная частица -то (через дефис) присоединяется к знаменательному слову, чтобы выделить его как тему («Погода-то хорошая!»), уступить перед «но» («Сделать-то я сделал, но...») или смягчить высказывание. Это выделительная -то, а не неопределённая -то из «кто-то / где-то».
intro: The same two letters you learned as an indefinite marker, doing an unrelated job. Telling them apart is mechanical: on a question word it is the indefinite one, on anything else it is this one. Here it spotlights the topic, or concedes a point before a 'but'. It is informal and belongs in speech.
rules: Tell the two -то apart by the host word: on a question stem it is indefinite 'some-' (кто-то, где-то) and not this lesson; on an ordinary content word it is the emphatic particle (Книгу-то я прочитал). Both use a hyphen.
Emphatic -то marks the topic: Погода-то хорошая! It lifts a word out as the thing being commented on, often warmly or with mild surprise.
Emphatic -то concedes a point before a 'but': the pattern is verb + -то + same verb ..., но/а ... (Сделать-то я сделал, но плохо).
Emphatic -то can soften and add low-key emphasis: Он-то знает дорогу ('he, at least, knows the way').
The -то is unstressed, written with a hyphen on the word it follows, and is informal: keep it out of formal writing.
examples: Погода-то хорошая! (The weather, now that's nice!) emphatic -то spotlights погода as the topic.
Сделать-то я сделал, но плохо. (Do it I did, but badly.) -то concedes before a 'but.'
Понять-то я понял, но согласиться не могу. (Understand it I did, but I can't agree.) the verb + -то + verb concessive rhythm.
Он-то знает дорогу. (He, at least, knows the way.) -то softly emphasizes 'he.'
Книгу-то я прочитал. (The book, well, that I did read.) -то makes книгу the topic.
Деньги-то есть, а времени нет. (Money we have, but time we don't.) -то sets up the contrast that а completes.

tables.title: Two kinds of -то, and the jobs of the emphatic one

items.prompt: Which -то is the EMPHATIC (topic) particle, not the indefinite 'some-' suffix?
items.hint: Emphatic -то attaches to an ordinary content word; indefinite -то sits on a question word.
items.explanation: Погода-то...!Attaches -то to the content word погода to spotlight it as the topic ('the weather, now that's great!'), which is the emphatic particle. The other three (кто-то, где-то, почему-то) attach -то to question stems to build indefinite 'some-' words, a different -то entirely.

items.prompt: Concession before a 'but' ('Do it I did, but badly.'): _____ я сделал, но плохо.
items.promptEnglish: Do it I did, but badly.
items.hint: The pattern is verb + -то ..., но ... It concedes one point before objecting.
items.explanation: Сделать-то я сделал, но плохо follows the concessive pattern verb + -то ..., но ... ('do it I did, but...'). The emphatic -то grants the point before the 'but.' ли would form a question, же is a sharper underline without the concessive rhythm, and что-то сделать ('do something') uses the indefinite -то, the wrong one here.

items.prompt: What does -то add in 'Он-то знает дорогу'?
items.promptEnglish: What is the effect of -то here?
options: It turns the sentence into a question
A soft topical emphasis on 'he' ('he, at least, knows')
items.answer: A soft topical emphasis on 'he' ('he, at least, knows')
items.hint: Emphatic -то on a content word spotlights it; it does not build a 'some-' word here.
items.explanation: On the pronoun он, -то gives a soft, topical emphasis: 'he, at any rate, knows the way.' Because он is a content word, not a question stem, this is the emphatic -то, not the indefinite suffix (which would need a question word like кто-то). It neither questions nor negates.

items.prompt: Topic-spotlight with warmth ('The book, well, that I did read.'): _____ я прочитал.
items.promptEnglish: The book, well, that I did read.
items.hint: Which form makes 'the book' the topic of the comment?
items.explanation: Книгу-то я прочитал uses emphatic -то to lift книгу out as the topic ('as for the book, that I did read'). Книга ли would form a yes-no question and uses the wrong case, же would add a sharper insistence, and что-то is the indefinite 'something'. The warm topic-spotlight is -то's job.

items.prompt: Which sentence uses the EMPHATIC -то correctly to concede a point?
items.promptEnglish: Choose the correct concessive use of emphatic -то.
options: Где-то я понял, но согласиться не могу.
Понять-то я понял, но согласиться не могу.
Понять ли я понял, но согласиться не могу.
Кто-то понял, но согласиться не могу.
items.answer: Понять-то я понял, но согласиться не могу.
items.hint: The concessive rhythm is verb + -то + same verb ..., но ...
items.explanation: Понять-то я понял, но...Is the concessive pattern: -то on the verb grants the point ('understand it I did') before the 'but.' Где-то ('somewhere') and кто-то ('someone') are indefinite words that break the meaning, and Понять ли would launch a question rather than a concession.

items.prompt: Sets up a contrast ('Money we have, but time we don't.'): Деньги-то есть, _____ времени нет.
items.promptEnglish: Money we have, but time we don't.
items.hint: Деньги-то есть concedes one point with -то; which connector marks the 'but/whereas' that follows?
items.explanation: Деньги-то есть, а времени нет follows the concessive rhythm X-то ..., а/но ... The emphatic -то on деньги grants the first point, and а ('but/whereas') marks the contrast.Ли would form a question, же would over-emphasize, and the pointer вот does not connect two contrasting clauses this way.

items.promptEnglish: The book, well, that I did read - but the film I haven't seen.
items.explanation: -то clips onto the fronted topic: Книгу-то я прочитал ('the book I DID read'). Бы would make it hypothetical; ли a question; the infinitive cannot carry the clause.

items.promptEnglish: Money we have, but time we don't.
items.explanation: The -то concession pairs with a contrast: Деньги-то есть, а времени нет. И would add rather than contrast; же and то cannot introduce the second half.

items.prompt: _____ я слышал, но ничего не понял.
items.promptEnglish: Hear it I heard, but I didn't understand anything.
items.explanation: The concessive doubles the verb with -то on the fronted infinitive: Слышать-то я слышал, но... Же, ли, and вот cannot build this concede-one-point frame.

blanks: _____ хорошая, давай погуляем! (The weather, now that's nice, let's take a walk!)
Деньги-то есть, _____ времени нет. (Money we have, but time we don't.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: First blank: emphatic -то on the content word погода spotlights it as the topic (Погода-то хорошая!). Second blank: the X-то ..., а/но ...Concessive rhythm needs the contrast connector а ('but/whereas') after Деньги-то.
hints: Which form makes 'the weather' the topic, with a warm 'now that's...' feel?
Деньги-то есть concedes one point; which connector marks the 'but/whereas' contrast?
explanations: Погода-то хорошая lifts погода out as the topic, the warm 'as for the weather' spotlight of emphatic -то. Погода ли would form a yes-no question, not a comment.

Деньги-то есть, а времени нет follows the concessive pattern X-то ..., а/но ... The -то grants the first point ('money we do have'), and а marks the contrast. ли would form a question, же would over-emphasize, and вот would point rather than connect.

sentenceBuilding.translation: The weather, now that's nice today.
Do it I did, but badly.

sentenceBuilding.answer: Понять-то я понял, но согласиться не могу
sentenceBuilding.translation: Understand it I did, but I can't agree.
acceptableVariants: Понять-то я понял но согласиться не могу

sentenceBuilding.translation: He, at least, knows the way.

errorCorrection.sentence: Что-то погода сегодня хорошая, давай погуляем.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: The weather, now that's nice today, let's take a walk.
errorCorrection.explanation: Emphatic -то attaches to the content word погода to spotlight it as the topic, often with warmth: Погода-то хорошая! = 'The weather, now that's nice!' Что-то is the indefinite 'something', the wrong -то here. Погода ли would form a yes-no question ('is it the weather?'), not a comment, and Погода же would add a sharper, insistent stress rather than the warm topic-spotlight the gloss needs.

errorCorrection.sentence: Прочитать же я прочитал статью, но ничего не понял.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Read the article I did, but I understood nothing.
errorCorrection.explanation: Emphatic -то concedes one point before a 'but': Прочитать-то я прочитал, но... = 'Read it I did, but...', the classic verb + -то + verb + но rhythm. Же adds insistence rather than concession, so it cannot set up the coming contrast.

errorCorrection.sentence: Где-то я понял задание, но решить его не смог.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Understand the task I did, but I couldn't solve it.
errorCorrection.explanation: The concessive rhythm needs the verb repeated with emphatic -то: Понять-то я понял, но... = 'understand it I did, but...'. Где-то ('somewhere') is the indefinite word and breaks the meaning. Понять ли would launch a question, and Понять же would add insistence rather than the 'I did concede this much, but' nuance that -то gives.

minimalPairs.context: _____ стучит в дверь, я не знаю кто. (Goal: 'SOMEONE is knocking, I don't know who.')
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Someone is knocking; I don't know who.
minimalPairs.explanation: The indefinite -то on the question word кто builds 'someone': Кто-то стучит, which fits 'I don't know who.' Он-то ('he, at least') would use the emphatic -то on a known pronoun and contradicts not knowing who it is. This pair shows the test: -то on a question word is indefinite; -то on a content word is emphatic.

minimalPairs.context: _____ я прочитал, но ничего не понял. (Goal: concede, 'Read it I did, but I understood nothing.')
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Read it I did, but I understood nothing.
minimalPairs.explanation: Прочитать-то я прочитал, но...Uses emphatic -то in the concessive rhythm: 'read it I did, but...'. Что-то ('something') is the indefinite word and would change the meaning to 'I read something', breaking the verb + -то + verb concession. The host word tells them apart: a verb takes the emphatic -то, a question stem the indefinite one.

patternRecognition.sentence: Понять-то я понял, но согласиться не могу.
patternRecognition.question: What is -то doing in Понять-то?
options: Building an indefinite word ('to understand somehow')
patternRecognition.explanation: Понять-то я понял, но... is the concessive verb + -то ..., но ... pattern: 'understand it I did, but I can't agree.' The emphatic -то grants one point before objecting. It is on a content word (the verb), so it is not the indefinite suffix; it neither questions nor points.

patternRecognition.question: How does -то function in Погода-то?
options: It spotlights погода as the topic ('as for the weather')
patternRecognition.answer: It spotlights погода as the topic ('as for the weather')
patternRecognition.explanation: Погода-то сегодня чудесная! puts emphatic -то on the content word погода to lift it out as the topic, with a warm 'as for the weather, it's wonderful!' feel. It does not build an indefinite word (that would need a question stem), does not question, and does not negate.

patternRecognition.sentence: Он-то знает дорогу, спроси у него.
patternRecognition.question: What does -то add to Он-то?
options: Soft, low-key emphasis ('he, at least, knows')
It turns the clause into a question
patternRecognition.answer: Soft, low-key emphasis ('he, at least, knows')
patternRecognition.explanation: Он-то знает дорогу uses emphatic -то to give a soft, topical emphasis on он: 'he, at any rate, knows the way, ask him.' On a content pronoun this is the emphatic particle, not the indefinite suffix; it does not question or mark identity.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort each -то by whether it is the INDEFINITE 'some-' suffix (on a question word) or the EMPHATIC topic/concession particle (on a content word).

reviewVocab.definition: topic/emphasis particle attached with a hyphen to a content word: spotlights it (Погода-то хорошая!), concedes before a 'but' (Сделать-то я сделал, но...), or softens (Он-то знает). Informal and warm.
reviewVocab.example: Книгу-то я прочитал. / Понять-то я понял, но...

reviewVocab.definition: the concessive rhythm: repeat the verb with -то to grant a point, then contrast with но or а. 'Do/understand/hear it I did, but...'.
reviewVocab.example: Сделать-то я сделал, но плохо. / Слышать-то я слышал, а ничего не понял.

reviewVocab.definition: the DIFFERENT -то: an indefinite suffix on a question stem making 'some-' words. Tell it from emphatic -то by the host: question word = indefinite, content word = emphatic.
reviewVocab.example: Кто-то пришёл (someone) versus Пришёл-то он вовремя (he did come on time).
